title: 修车店：描述问题和问价格
summary: 车有异响、要保养：跟修车师傅描述问题、先问报价再修，不被乱收费。

featuredPhrase.en: My car is making a strange noise.

phrases.en: My car is making a strange noise.
How much will the repair cost?
Is this covered by the warranty?
When will my car be ready?
phrases.zh: 我的车什么时候能修好？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, my car is making a strange noise when I brake.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我踩刹车时车有异响。

dialogue.speaker: Mechanic
dialogue.en: Let me take a look. How long has this been going on?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: About a week. How much will the repair cost?
dialogue.zh: 大概一周了，修一下多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Mechanic
dialogue.en: Your brake pads are worn out. It'll be about $250.
dialogue.zh: 刹车片磨没了，大概要 250 美元。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Is this covered by the warranty?

dialogue.speaker: Mechanic
dialogue.en: Brake pads are wear and tear, so no. But I can have it ready by 4.
dialogue.zh: 刹车片算损耗件，不保。不过 4 点前能修好。
